# U39: Something changed: what changed, what happens next and by when on one screen; the walkthrough coach never covers what it points at

- **Belongs to:** the Goal map module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `ONE-ACCOUNT`, `PATH-TO-GREEN`, `WALKTHROUGHS`
- **Budget:** at most 14 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `entry` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Chen, at `/check-in/dep-jenkins` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U39

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Chen (`chen`).
- Go to `/check-in/dep-jenkins` in the demo.
- _Note:_ Before a number is typed the button doesn't promise to post.
- **Step.** Type {a number 40% of the way from the goal’s start to its plan for week 45} into the “This week’s value” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Something changed” button.
- _Note:_ One screen: the cause, the account, the way back and the week, with last week's words to edit.
- **Check:** The “What changed, and what happens next” section shows.
- **Check:** (`one-action`) met when `oneScreen && prefilled && steps === 'Step 3 of 3' && before === 'Continue'`, where `const before = await p.locator('form.focus-body button[type=submit]').innerText()`; `const account = p.getByRole('region', { name: 'What changed, and what happens next' })`; `const steps = await p.locator('.dots').getAttribute('aria-label')`; `const oneScreen = await account.getByRole('group', { name: 'Main cause' }).isVisible() && await account.getByRole('radiogroup', { name: 'Where you are' }).isVisible()`; `const prefilled = (await account.getByLabel('What happened').inputValue()).length > 10`. Else it says: one screen {oneScreen}, last week’s words {prefilled}, progress “{steps}”, first button “{before}”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “one account”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ An empty account is explained where it's missing, not posted.
- Empty the “What happened” field in the “What changed, and what happens next” section.
- Press the “Post check-in” button.
- **Check:** (`errors`) an alert showing “Write a sentence about what happened” is visible (else: an empty account is not explained).
- **Step.** Type “The payments team’s release train changed, so the Jenkins jobs we planned to retire were pinned for a new pipeline.” into the “What happened” field in the “What changed, and what happens next” section.
- **Step.** Press the “I have a plan” choice in the “What changed, and what happens next” section.
- **Step.** Type “Relabel the pinned jobs this week, then retire the Jenkins agents.” into the “What changes?” field in the “What changed, and what happens next” section.
- **Step.** Press a button in the “Back on plan by” group in the “What changed, and what happens next” section.
- **Step.** Press the “Post check-in” button.
- **Check:** “Check-in saved” is shown.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `!!c && /new pipeline/.test(c.why) && /Relabel/.test(c.pathToGreen?.what ?? '') && (c.pathToGreen?.byWeek ?? 0) > NOW`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`; `const c = s.checkIns.filter((x) => x.goalId === 'dep-jenkins').sort((a, b) => a.postedAt.localeCompare(b.postedAt)).pop()`; `NOW` is 45. Else it says: the account was not saved whole.
- _Note:_ The goal page says whose date is whose: the owner's recovery date and the app's projection.
- Go to `/goals/dep-jenkins` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Owner’s date: back on plan by” is shown (else: the owner’s date is not labelled as theirs).
- _Note:_ The chart's footnote: "Likely end projected from the last eight weeks, not the owner’s date." (the scorecard, 5 Nov).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `proj > 0`, where `const proj = await p.getByText(/projected from the last eight weeks, not the owner’s date/i).count()`. Else it says: the projection is not labelled as the app’s estimate.
- _Note:_ The map walkthrough: the coach sits beside the goal it points at, never on it.
- Look as Amara (`amara`) in the workspace `platform-org` from here on, as choosing them in the Demo panel does (the browser’s storage: `goals-app-viewer:platform-org` is `amara`).
- Go to `/goals?scope=all&view=map` in the demo.
- **Check:** A goal on the Goal map shows.
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `() => { sessionStorage.setItem('goals-tour', JSON.stringify({ id: 'map', step: 1 })); window.dispatchEvent(new Event('goals-tour')); }`.
- **Check:** The coach (`.coach`) shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `clear.ok`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`; `const c = s.checkIns.filter((x) => x.goalId === 'dep-jenkins').sort((a, b) => a.postedAt.localeCompare(b.postedAt)).pop()`; `` const clear = await p.evaluate(() => { const c = document.querySelector('.coach')?.getBoundingClientRect(); const r = document.querySelector('.coach-ring')?.getBoundingClientRect(); if (!c || !r) return { ok: false, why: `coach ${!!c}, ring ${!!r}` }; const hit = c.left < r.right && c.right > r.left && c.top < r.bottom && c.bottom > r.top; const inView = c.left >= 0 && c.top >= 0 && c.right <= innerWidth && c.bottom <= innerHeight; return { ok: !hit && inView, why: `coach ${Math.round(c.left)},${Math.round(c.top)} ${Math.round(c.width)}×${Math.round(c.height)}; ring ${Math.round(r.left)},${Math.round(r.top)} ${Math.round(r.width)}×${Math.round(r.height)}` }; }) ``. Else it says: the coach covers what it points at, or is off screen: {clear.why}.
- **Check:** (`finish`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
